verdict.rationale: BILL documents several specific background automations a user can enable: vendor autopay that pays automatically when a bill is created, recurring bill templates for periodic payments, an AI Invoice Coding Agent, and AI spend management that categorizes transactions automatically. These are fixed, feature-specific automations, not a general facility for building your own autonomous workflows, and several sit on the AP side rather than in Spend & Expense itself. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/workflow builder with custom triggers and actions, S&E-specific autonomous agent behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: When this feature is enabled for a vendor, BILL automatically pays the vendor when a bill is created for the vendor.
A recurring bill is a template for creating identical bills for periodic payments to a vendor.
Automatic AI multi-line bill coding with the Invoice Coding Agent
AI-powered spend management —so every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant.
